messages.author: Rodrigo Galindo-Murillo
messages.body:
Hello!
There is an open position for a 2024 summer intern in Computational
Chemistry in the Medicinal Chemistry Department at IONIS pharmaceuticals.
If you are curious what industry has to offer and are passionate about
understanding the structure and dynamics of DNA/RNA-protein interactions
consider applying following the link:
https://recruiting.ultipro.com/ISI1000ISIS/JobBoard/14a66400-68fa-4847-8593-af776328cfd2/OpportunityDetail?opportunityId=16e70d2a-d6e5-4f52-b348-344eb413ae87
or
https://www.ionispharma.com/careers/ionis-intern/
The internship is for an undergrad or 1st/2nd year grad student interested
in doing Molecular Dynamics simulations of modified oligonucleotides. The
position is fully remote.
Thank you!
Rodrigo.
